text: We're not new customers here, and we've been using their services since they were at the Udom Suk branch before they moved to On Nut. However, we feel the service has deteriorated significantly, especially regarding appointments. We called to schedule an appointment three days in advance. On the day of our appointment, a Sunday at 4 PM, there was no record of our call. The dentist had already left, and they said the last appointment was at around 3 PM. The staff themselves didn't seem interested in providing good service or trying to resolve the situation. They just checked that the number was legitimate and that we hadn't made an appointment at the wrong branch, and then simply asked if we were available on another day. If that's all they can do, we'd rather go elsewhere. There are plenty of other dental clinics in Bangkok. It was a complete waste of time traveling and very disappointing. If you don't want to retain customers, then please continue doing the same thing.
